title: Möbius transport on spheres
summary: The Möbius transformation that generates the spherical Cauchy distribution from the uniform is the tangent-normal lift of a one-dimensional optimal transport: the monotone rearrangement of the cosine about the location axis. This identifies the probabilistic nature of the Möbius transformation and suggests a generalization: replacing the Cauchy target by any rotationally symmetric law, for instance the Poisson kernel or spherical cardioid, yields a generalized Möbius transformation.
